The a23ae3b canonical-target alias shortcut reopened one particular alias in 0.006208621 s with byte-exact products, but review proved that two aliases to the same master inode can resolve relative HDF5 links to different shards. The shortcut is refuted; the accepted reader requires exact normalized master spelling or full HDF5 reinspection.

The exact batch-2 candidate measured 1.128484/1.140200/1.141501 s p50/p95/max over three prepared-index, source-pages-unspecified physical-Phil loads. It missed the strict subsecond gate and did not improve the separately accepted 1.080860-second single observation, so the patch was reverted and its timing is not promoted.
